name: Shandong New Beiyang Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong New Beiyang Information Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sales of printing and scanning solutions. The company offers Pos's printers, label and kiosk printers, and other products; cash deposit machines, cash recycling solutions, and teller cash recyclers; self-service terminals, such as vending machines, logistics cabinets, and food lockers; and logistic automation products. It serves food and hospitality, retail, logistics, finance, lottery, healthcare, manufacturing, and government services sectors.
